headline: Defender's mutants were statues. Now they hunt.
lede: Auditing why the patrol kept dying on Jupiter found the real bug under the arc: hunt-state mutants never actually moved — their chase velocity was computed every tick and thrown away. The fix makes the 1981 hunter honest, and the autopilot was re-tuned to fight it: 19+16 of 40 seeds now survive the full horizon (was 1), banks jumped ~8x, and every wave closes.

notes.text: The statue bug: the sim's movement block is lander-only, so mutants sat frozen while the README swore 'chases you'. Every logged mutant kill for two seasons was flying into a fixture — including the numbers WITNESS certified.

watchRoute stage 2: terrain seat with sink-and-rise margins, canyon turns, pulsed descents, hover-kill (the laser closes at 20 whatever the hull does), turn-and-brace against tail hunters. Terrain deaths 97 across both sets -> 6.
WITNESS re-pinned to the honest numbers and its mortality tripwire flipped: survival progress made '>=15 honest game-overs per set' wrong by design — now the pin demands the pilot still bleeds.
Stage 3 queued on #3456: the elevator still gets hunted mid-haul (23 packages lost across 40 seeds) — the next honest gap.

look.text: Fly Jupiter against the first honest mutant hunt — and watch the autopilot …
